title: Non-canonical inverse hints (b^-1 + modulus) are harmless by construction

title: Randomized differential: prover trie engine vs reference trie builder, 15980 bundles, 0 mismatches
root_cause: No divergence: TrieDB::state_root (proof/mpt walker over hash-keyed witness nodes) equals alloy-trie HashBuilder for Changed, InMemoryChange, Destroyed, DestroyedChanged and DestroyedAgain entries with unchanged, zeroed, new and overwritten slots; a non-destroyed entry without account info is always the MissingAccountInfo hard error.
discovery_method: Deterministic xorshift fuzz: random pre-state, 1..=3 bundles per round, fresh prover trie per bundle with the pre-bundle root in its parent header and basic() loads before sealing.
payload: targets/base/crates/proof/proof/tests/s3_root_probe.rs::s3_root_mpt_fuzz (S3_FUZZ_ROUNDS=8000)
takeaway: Executed negative for the destroyed/recreated + storage-collapse classes. Preconditions that a fresh-trie fuzz MUST reproduce or it produces ~20 percent false mismatches: parent header state_root = pre-bundle root; every touched account loaded through basic() before state_root (fills the storage-root cache); no storage under non-existent accounts; bundle is a map keyed by address and slots keyed by slot.

title: Scar: five false alarm waves in one day, all harness faults; each found by dumping the first failing case
root_cause: New differential harnesses mismatched for harness reasons: hard-coded reference parameters without the production fork config; test contracts that never executed the intended opcode path; witness missing code created mid-range; fuzz trie built on a zero root / without account loads / with phantom storage / with duplicate keys.
discovery_method: For each wave: print per-item raw results (receipts, ExecutionResult, bundle entries), isolate the smallest unit (EVM-level inspect_tx; single-entry bundle dump), fix the harness, re-run.
payload: order of operations: suspect harness -> dump first failing case -> isolate -> fix -> re-run -> only then classify as target behaviour
takeaway: When a brand-new harness reports a mismatch, the prior is on the harness. Budget for it: each of the five waves here was resolved by one targeted dump, and none survived. Record the wave as a scar either way.
